# Get-ZbxDiscoveredService

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the discovered services that network discovery found on discovered hosts.

## SYNTAX

### All (Default)

```
Get-ZbxDiscoveredService [-Limit <int>] [-SortField <string[]>] [-Id <ulong[]>] [-DiscoveredHost <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDiscoveredHost>[]>] [-NetworkDiscoveryCheck <ZabbixReference<ZabbixNetworkDiscoveryCheck>[]>] [-NetworkDiscoveryRule <ZabbixReference<ZabbixNetworkDiscoveryRule>[]>] [-SelectNetworkDiscoveryRules] [-SelectDHosts] [-SelectHosts] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ById

```
Get-ZbxDiscoveredService [-SortField <string[]>] -Id <ulong[]> [-DiscoveredHost <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDiscoveredHost>[]>] [-NetworkDiscoveryCheck <ZabbixReference<ZabbixNetworkDiscoveryCheck>[]>] [-NetworkDiscoveryRule <ZabbixReference<ZabbixNetworkDiscoveryRule>[]>] [-SelectNetworkDiscoveryRules] [-SelectDHosts] [-SelectHosts] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByFilter

```
Get-ZbxDiscoveredService [-SortField <string[]>] -Filter <ZabbixDiscoveredServiceGetParameters> [-DiscoveredHost <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDiscoveredHost>[]>] [-NetworkDiscoveryCheck <ZabbixReference<ZabbixNetworkDiscoveryCheck>[]>] [-NetworkDiscoveryRule <ZabbixReference<ZabbixNetworkDiscoveryRule>[]>] [-SelectNetworkDiscoveryRules] [-SelectDHosts] [-SelectHosts] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A discovered service is a service network discovery found on a discovered host: its port, the check that found it, and when it was last up or down. The Get-ZbxDiscoveredService cmdlet reads them with dservice.get: all of them up to -Limit, by id with -Id or from the pipeline, or with the whole dservice.get selection in -Filter. -DiscoveredHost, -NetworkDiscoveryCheck and -NetworkDiscoveryRule narrow the result to the discovered services of the objects given, each a name, an id or a piped object. It writes ZabbixDiscoveredService objects, with their related objects when a -Select switch asks for them, or, with -CountOutput, the number of matches; it needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get the discovered services of a network discovery rule

```powershell
Get-ZbxDiscoveredService -NetworkDiscoveryRule 'Local network'
```

Gets the discovered services of the network discovery rule Local network. -NetworkDiscoveryRule takes a name, an id or an object; a network discovery rule piped from Get-ZbxNetworkDiscoveryRule binds to it by its NetworkDiscoveryRuleId property.

### Example 2: Count discovered services

```powershell
Get-ZbxDiscoveredService -CountOutput
```

Writes how many discovered services the server has, without reading them.
